transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have the state regulator's subpoena regarding the Orion procurement program, and our response deadline is June 30, 2026. I understand the team has collected approximately 1,200 potentially responsive documents from the designated systems. Before I can approve any production plan, we need to go through our closeout process. Let's start with the round-robin status check in the usual order: discovery, privacy, employment, and risk. I'll need all four reports complete before I can submit the closeout form, and the form requires commitments under each action label—protective_order, trade_secret_review, medical_redaction, privilege_log, and insurer_coordination. For insurer_coordination specifically, I'll need both written notice and written consent documented before production. Who's here to give the discovery report first?
